title: What's new in v2.72.0
content:
Features:
- Custom pixel ratio
- New cel operations: shifting and rippling deletion.

Enhancements:
- When in frame multi-select mode, drag-and-drop will select the frame range.
- Added stabilizer and alpha-lock toggle to gesture pad, joystick, and keyboard shortcuts.

Fixes:
- Incorrect onion skin index with tags.
- Polygon with corner radius being cut off when the corners are outside the canvas.
